promotionalText: Master Turkey's physical, human, and economic geography with an interactive 3D relief atlas, 17 thematic layers, 81 provinces, flashcards, and timed KPSS mock exams.
description:
GeoKPSS is the complete interactive 3D Physical Relief Map and Geography Atlas of Turkey designed for KPSS, YKS, and geography learners. Explore 81 provinces (il & plaka), mountain ranges, tectonic fault lines (deprem & fay), lakes, rivers, minerals, agriculture, 14 official Ramsar wetlands, and 24 UNESCO ancient cities (antik kent).

KEY FEATURES:
• 3D Hypsometric Relief & Elevation Map (Fiziki Kabartma): Interactive 5-band altitude scale from 0–500 m coastal deltas to 2,000 m+ Eastern Anatolian plateaus.
• 17 Thematic Geography Layers: Mountains, Lakes, Plateaus (platolar), Rivers, Coasts, Earthquake Faults, Vegetation & Soil, Climate, Population, Agriculture & Livestock, Minerals, Industry, Transport, Regional Projects, 14 Ramsar Wetlands, and 24 Ancient Cities.
• Blind Map Quiz & Timed Mock Exams (Sinav): Locate features on the blind map or solve multiple-choice and true/false questions with spaced repetition flashcards (kart).
